abilities.name: Fortitude of the Faithful
abilities.description: When at least 1 other allied Hero is nearby, Deckard gains 10 Armor and his Basic Abilities recharge 50% faster.; trait

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other effects that can affect cooldown refresh rate. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Healing Potion
abilities.description: Throw a Healing Potion on the ground that heals the first allied Hero who comes in contact with it for 285. Limit 5 active Potions.

fields.val2: - Range 0 - 3.0: 0.125 seconds - Range 3.0 - 6.0: 0.375 seconds - Range 6.0+: 0.5 seconds
fields.notes: Healing Potion cannot be cast on unpathable terrain. Healing Potions do not grant any vision. Healing Potions cannot be picked up by Heroes at full health. Allies can see the landing location of the potion while it's in the air. Potions on the ground are also visible to the enemy.

abilities.name: Horadric Cube
abilities.description: Release the Horadric Cube. After 0.5 seconds it explodes, dealing 80 damage to all enemies in the area and Slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Scroll of Sealing
abilities.description: Unfurl an enchanted scroll over 2.25 seconds, forming a triangle that deals 150 damage to enemies inside and Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
abilities.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after. Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Stationary channel, Sleep
fields.notes: Interrupting the ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Sleep cannot be interrupted for the first 0.5 seconds. Sleep counts as a Stun effect and interacts with all effects that interact with Stuns.

abilities.name: Lorenado
abilities.description: After 1 second, create a swirling tome tornado that travels in the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 damage to Heroes hit.

fields.notes: Removes existing knockback effects from the target. Enemies cannot be hit by Lorenado while a knockback from it is still active on them.

talents.name: Scroll of Identify
talents.description: Quest Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2. After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds. reward After hitting 30 Heroes this Talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier, Status effect / Bonus damage
fields.notes: Continues to gain stacks after the Quests have been completed. Armor debuff and bonus damage is applied after the damage is dealt. The second Quest Reward also increases the duration of the reveal. Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Quest Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2. After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds. reward After hitting 30 Heroes this Talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.

talents.name: Field Study
talents.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

fields.type: Healing dealt modifier, Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Spell Power is calculated after damage is dealt. Spell Power from Field Study stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers affecting Deckard.

_raw_fields: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

talents.name: Sapphire
talents.description: Cooldown 30 Active Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and its slow by 30%. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

fields.notes: A Gem goes on cooldown once the Horadric Cube is cast. An activated Gem can be deactivated only by activating another Gem. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 30 Active Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and its slow by 30%. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

talents.name: Potion of Shielding
talents.description: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140 Shield for 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Shield from Potion of Healing does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the amount and duration.

_raw_fields: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140 Shield for 6 seconds.

talents.name: Rejuvenation Potion
talents.description: Healing Potions restore 15 Mana and heal for an additional 114 over 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Healing-over-time does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the duration.

_raw_fields: Healing Potions restore 15 Mana and heal for an additional 114 over 3 seconds.

talents.name: Ruby
talents.description: Cooldown 20 Active Activate to increase the next Horadric Cube's damage by 100% and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

fields.notes: A Gem goes on cooldown once the Horadric Cube is cast. An activated Gem can be deactivated only by activating another Gem. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 20 Active Activate to increase the next Horadric Cube's damage by 100% and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

talents.name: Cube Mastery
talents.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25. Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.
_raw_fields: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25. Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.

talents.name: Kanai's Cube
talents.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage debuff stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target Hero's damage output.

_raw_fields: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Emerald
talents.description: Cooldown 30 Active Activate to make the next Horadric Cube reduce healing received by 75% for 4 seconds. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

fields.type: Healing received modifier / Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: A Gem goes on cooldown once the Horadric Cube is cast. An activated Gem can be deactivated only by activating another Gem. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers. Healing reduction stacks additively with other healing received modifiers.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 30 Active Activate to make the next Horadric Cube reduce healing received by 75% for 4 seconds. Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

talents.name: Super Healing Potion
talents.description: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more. Passive Healing Potion heals for 25% more if the target is below 50% Health.

fields.notes: Does not benefit the additional healing from Rejuvenation Potion. Bonuses stack additively with themselves and other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Healing Potion 's healing.

_raw_fields: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more. Passive Healing Potion heals for 25% more if the target is below 50% Health.

talents.name: Potion of Revival
talents.description: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.

fields.notes: Only the primary target of Healing Potion benefits from additional effects from talents, such as Potion of Shielding and Rejuvenation Potion. Reduction to healing amount stacks additively with healing dealt modifiers that can affect Healing Potion 's healing.

_raw_fields: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.

talents.name: Ancient Blessings
talents.description: Cooldown 45 Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 damage in an area and heal for 90 for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Modifier, Splash
fields.notes: Ancient Blessings is independent from Fortitude of the Faithful 's aura - The buff is applied one time upon cast to allies within the talent's radius for 8 seconds. The affected allies are not required to remain near Deckard to keep gaining its benefits. The damage is dealt in a separate instance of Spell Damage. The damage and healing are affected by the offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers on the attacker. Deckard's modifiers only affects his own attacks. The bonus damage is scored to the attacker, but the healing is scored to Deckard.

_raw_fields: Cooldown 45 Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 damage in an area and heal for 90 for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

talents.name: Scroll of Stone Curse
talents.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

fields.notes: Bonus damage stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Scroll of Sealing 's damage.

_raw_fields: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

talents.name: Safety in Numbers
talents.description: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.
_raw_fields: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.

talents.description: Every 5 seconds, Deckard's next Basic Attack Stuns Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

talents.description: Stay Awhile and Listen Silences and Blinds enemies for 3 seconds upon waking up from Sleep.

talents.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

fields.notes: Recharged potions benefit from every talent affecting Healing Potion, including this talent.

talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.
